headline: Expanse Swings Colonial as Berm Holds Warden
war_summary: Since the 06:11 edition the wires to the 09:15 filing show the Weathered Expanse swinging hard, now counting one Warden, six Colonial and two unheld holdings after nine changes in two hours and sixty-four on the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, with twenty-four-hour losses of 8,452 Colonial and 12,163 Warden. Palantine Berm has steadied under full Warden holding at seven, after five changes in two hours and fifty-four on the day about The Droll, The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni. Callahan's Passage shows nine Warden and one unheld after two changes in two hours and thirty-three on the day about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, with 10,651 Colonial and 12,161 Warden losses on the day. Stlican Shelf adds one change to the cutoff and twenty-four on the day about Breaker Town and Port of Rime, while Stonecradle posts three in two hours and eleven on the day about The Reach. The Nevish Line, Callums Cape and Kuura Strand report no changes in the last two hours, the Nevish wire last moving the prior evening.
